method_summary: This selector replaces the bipartite matching and cluster-pick strategies with a single efficient greedy facility-location selection across the top-k*40 quality candidates, jointly maximizing uncertainty and minimum feature-distance to already-chosen pairs. Pivot-based uncertainty-weighted sampling still seeds an approximate density/quality score, but final selection uses vectorized argmax over a cached min-distance array for speed and consistency across all rounds 1–39.
